debrief db-021
1) the actor s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-d the c-o-v-e-r-b-i-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-a-l, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d p-r-i-c-i-n-g m-a-t-r-i-x, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-r-a-c-e in the s-e-n-d l-o-g, a-n-d the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t q-u-o-t-e r-e-v-i-e-w was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
2) the actor r-o-u-t-e-d the h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n p-a-y-m-e-n-t s, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d o-f-f-b-o-o-k b-a-n-k a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d in the l-e-d-g-e-r, a-n-d the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l a-u-d-i-t c-h-e-c-k was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
3) the actor e-x-c-h-a-n-g-e-d the j-o-i-n-t p-r-i-c-i-n-g i-n-f-o r-m-a-t-i-o-n, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d c-l-o-u-d d-r-i-v-e s-h-a-r-i-n-g, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a v-i-e-w-a-b-l-e f-i-l-e-h-i-s-t-o-r-y, a-n-d the d-a-t-a-r-o-o-m i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
4) the actor s-i-g-n-e-d the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n a-g-r-e-e-m-e-n-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d a s-h-a-r-e-d c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r s-h-e-e-t, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a c-o-m-m-i-t l-o-g t-r-a-c-e, a-n-d the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e s-i-g-n-o-f-f was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
5) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d the f-a-k-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n d-o-c-s, w-h-i-c-h r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-h-a-r-e-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e s, w-h-i-c-h l-e-f-t a f-i-l-e n-a-m-i-n-g p-a-t-t-e-r-n, a-n-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n was the c-o-n-t-r-o-l b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d
